newsitem.title: USA: Kelley Oil, Williams unit to drill for gas.
newsitem.headline: Kelley Oil, Williams unit to drill for gas.

text.p: Kelley Oil & Gas Corp said Thursday it had entered into a joint venture with a unit of The Williams Companies Inc to explore for natural gas in southern Louisiana.
The company said said Williams Production - Gulf Coast Company L.P. bought a 50-percent interest in its 27,000 net acre position in the Houma Embayment in Terrebonne Parish, Louisiana.
The unit, a division of Williams Energy Group, paid $20.5 million for the interest, it said.
The company said it and the unit planned to begin exploratory drilling with the immediate spudding of the Wylie No. 8 in Section 84, Township 17 South, Range 16 East.
